method.execution: S2 clean detached local worktree, Python 3.11.3, pytest 9.0.2, SQLite 3.39.5, macOS 13.2.1 x86_64
method.direct_sql: sqlite3.connect on the real DB; DROP TRIGGER <table>_no_update to model a raw-DB writer; UPDATE; commit
method.restore: restore exact original DB (and sidecar/meta/journal/proof where mutated) from byte backups; reopen/verify
method.raw_preimage_rule: episode: digest(body without hash and without post-hash episode_id); world_event/checkpoint: digest(body/state without hash); perception has no hash
method.not_run: No native C4/ADP/CAN008/CAN011/SCI05/Pyat, no production anchor/KMS, no human A5

bp2p4.c12_verify.verify_branch_chain.cause: verify_branch_chain recomputes the episode preimage without dropping the post-hash episode_id; every valid episode row fails. It is not a positive-control independent verifier.

upstream_bp4_C12Store.verify.cause: known upstream self-referential body hash; documented by the candidate

test_rrif_r2_c12.py_test_20.observed: It asserts verify_branch_chain(...)[ok] is false after forging an episode. That assertion passes for the wrong reason because the same function is already false on the intact store. It has no positive control.

C9C12_R2_C12_GUARD_READER.cause: R2 uses the old 7bf2 C12 store/plain branch root hash; the C9C12-R2 guard expects BP4_C12_FORK_ROOT@2 prefix/semantics. R2's fork is not accepted by the newer guard.

raw_hash_recompute.conclusion: All persisted episode/world_event/checkpoint rows recompute to their stored body hash and column hash. Perception has no hash and is only sequence-checked. These are self-consistency checks, not an external owner anchor.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop episode_no_update; add body.tampered_for_rrif_proof=true to root GM01_SOURCE episode; do not recompute hash.
Drop episode_no_update; add body.coordinated_note='attacker-authored-and-rehashed'; recompute episode body hash excluding episode_id and update column hash.
tamper_cases.expected: This is exactly the self-hash wall: a raw writer with SQLite and the public digest function can re-author a preimage.
tamper_cases.verdict: Coordinated rehash passes. A recomputed self-hash is not independent owner attestation.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop episode_no_update; change episode.actor_id column to TEST_ONLY_FOREIGN_ACTOR for root GM01_SOURCE; leave body and hashes untouched.
tamper_cases.expected: C12 verifier should bind row columns to the hashed body if column actor identity is material.
tamper_cases.verdict: R2 does not bind actor_id column; C9C12-R2's guard does.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop episode_no_update; change episode.clock column to 999 for root GM01_SOURCE; leave body and hashes untouched.
tamper_cases.expected: Clock metadata mutation should be RED if C12 binds row clock.
tamper_cases.verdict: R2 does not bind clock column; C9C12-R2's guard does.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop episode_no_update; change episode.episode_id column to TEST_ONLY_FOREIGN_EPISODE_ID; leave body and hashes untouched.
tamper_cases.expected: The verifier deliberately drops body episode_id from the preimage; the column still needs an identity check.
tamper_cases.verdict: R2's episode_id column is unbound and unverified; C9C12-R2 rejects it.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop episode_no_update; change episode.kind column from GM01_SOURCE to DO; body.kind stays GM01_SOURCE.
tamper_cases.expected: Column metadata divergence should be detectable.

observed.note: The consumer reads body.kind, so this column divergence had no observed behavior here; it remains unverified metadata.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop world_event_no_update; add body.coordinated_note to root world_event; recompute body hash and update column hash.
tamper_cases.expected: C12 catches only uncoordinated world-event edits.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop perception_no_update; change perception actor_id to TEST_ONLY_FOREIGN_ACTOR, clock to 999, channel to FORGED_CHANNEL on root seq 0.
tamper_cases.expected: A perception row with no hash cannot be integrity-checked by content.

observed.note: Only seq contiguity is checked; the schema has no hash column.

tamper_cases.verdict: Perception content is not tamper-evident. The R2 return correctly says 'perception: sequence integrity'; it must not be read as hashed perception.

tamper_cases.mutation: Drop checkpoint_no_update; add state.coordinated_note to root checkpoint seq 0; recompute state hash and update column hash.
tamper_cases.expected: Coordinated checkpoint rehash passes the self-consistency verifier.
tamper_cases.verdict: Self-hash-only; world/checkpoint material can be re-authored consistently without an external anchor.

tamper_cases.mutation: Change branch.created_clock and fork_clock to 999 and branch.root_hash to 64 'f' characters for first_session; do not touch C12 row hashes or session meta.
tamper_cases.expected: Branch/parent metadata must be bound by the branch verifier or an anchor.

observed.note: No-lineage validation checks only that the selected branch exists and its parent is root/empty; branch root_hash/created_clock are not hashed by C12.

tamper_cases.verdict: Branch rows are not covered by the R2 C12 verifier; C9C12-R2's guard rejects the old fork root.

tamper_cases.mutation: Use a lawful refusal source object (REFUSE_TOOL, b_quantity=0, b_event_hash=3e00199d533b793897cd8b9bdc0639830252c60588de732b46dfcec3cc3b9421) from a real RefusalSession; replace gm01_source in root/first_session GM01_SOURCE rows; recompute episode hashes; leave bp2_join/session meta original.
tamper_cases.expected: C12 self-hash passes; provenance must compare against C8/sidecar/meta.
tamper_cases.verdict: C12 alone cannot bind the source; C8/sidecar/meta is the next layer.

tamper_cases.mutation: As above, plus rewrite bp2_join.json r31j_source and session.json j_source to the same lawful refusal source.
tamper_cases.expected: C12/sidecar/meta agree, but C8 remains the outer source witness.
tamper_cases.verdict: C8 is the effective local source anchor; the C12/sidecar/meta set is not independently anchored.

tamper_cases.mutation: Rewrite the C8 journal gm01_pre_c9_source to REFUSE_TOOL; update event content_hash, identity_preimage/identity_digest, state_digest, ledger_prefix_digest, version_state_digest and commit_receipt_id; leave the .bp3proof sidecar original.
tamper_cases.expected: The keyed proof must bind receipt/state.
tamper_cases.verdict: The keyed C8 proof catches a coordinated journal rewrite without re-signing. The key and anchor live in the same user's local fixture tree; this is not an independent owner custodian.

tamper_cases.mutation: Directly UPDATE bp2/c9.sqlite target_state.body adding tampered_for_proof=true; leave persisted target/consumed hashes original.
tamper_cases.verdict: C9 target body is cross-bound by consumed state hash.

tamper_cases.mutation: Add coordinated_note to target_state.body and update bp2_join.json persisted.consumed_state_hash and artifacts.consumed_state_hash to the recomputed target digest.
tamper_cases.expected: If E2 receipt binds the target, a coordinated top-level note should still be rejected.
tamper_cases.verdict: C9 is more cross-linked than C12: the E2 receipt catches this coordinated note. That is still a self-hash/receipt chain, not owner attestation.

external_anchor_ceiling.qualified_c12: QualifiedC12Store.verify recomputes each row's stored body self-hash and column hash, plus contiguous seq. It does not hash all row columns, perception, branch rows, or a chain across rows, and it has no key, signature, monotonic anchor or independent custodian.
external_anchor_ceiling.witness_class: ExternalCheckpointWitness is defined at vendor/j/r26e/c12_integrity.py:83 but is not imported or used by joined/cli or the two tests. Its own docstring states the same-user attacker can rewrite DB and witness key; security_boundary=false; residual TRUST_CUSTODY_HOLD.
external_anchor_ceiling.c8_keyed_proof: The C8 journal proof is keyed and rejects a rewritten receipt without re-signing, but key_path and anchor_log are local fixture files in the same user's bp2 tree. This is a local write-capability/consistency boundary, not an owner-issued external attestation.
external_anchor_ceiling.c9_cross_link: The C9 target is additionally bound by the E2 receipt; a coordinated target note was refused at BP2_E2_NOT_ADMITTED. This is stronger than C12 but still a self-hash/receipt chain.
external_anchor_ceiling.conclusion: A recomputed self-hash or a locally re-signed keyed proof is NOT cryptographic independent owner attestation. The R2 return correctly stops at TEST_ONLY; any receiving owner must treat C12 as self-consistency evidence only.

verdict: R2 catches uncoordinated tampering and restores exactly, but its C12 verifier is self-hash-only and its new independent-verifier test is vacuous. The external anchor remains absent and explicitly owner-held.
